### Day 292: Acts 27:27–44
Author: Beth Moore
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/plus/books/portraits-of-devotion/portraits-of-devotion-day-292-acts-27-2744.html
Passage: Acts 27:42-43
Points:
- God provides an umbrella of protection and blessing through the faithfulness of His servants.
- Paul and Jonah present contrasting responses: Jonah fled God's call and brought distress, while Paul's obedience brought safety to others.
- Genuine obedience significantly impacts not only the individual believer but also the surrounding community during life's storms.
- Walking in obedience fosters lasting joy, whereas rebellion leaves a believer bitter and joyless even amidst success.
- Faithful believers become an anchor and shelter for loved ones, colleagues, and unbelievers caught in life's crises.

### Anchor of Unity - Today's Insight - August 14, 2024
Author: Chuck Swindoll
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/todays-insight-august-14-2024.html
Passage: Acts 27:29-32
Points:
- Dire circumstances often tempt people to panic, cut ties, and attempt an isolated escape.
- Paul understood that abandoning ship would bring disaster and that survival required sticking together.
- Human nature tends toward withdrawal during pain, but isolation only worsens despair.
- God did not design people to weather life's storms alone without community and mutual support.
- Clinging to the anchor of unity with family and God's people helps sustain faith through severe trials.
